topic: Shopify Partner Program 2027: Select, Plus and Premier tiers retire
caption:
Shopify is retiring its “Plus Partner” tier. But the Partner Program isn't going anywhere.

On November 4, Shopify announced a new tier model for service and agency partners, effective January 1, 2027.

Select, Plus and Premier are retiring. The new tiers are Silver, Gold, Platinum and Diamond.

Here's what matters more than the names:

→ Qualification now depends on BOTH attributed GMV and the number of shops you launched or transferred.
→ Silver starts at $25K in attributed GMV and one attributed shop over a year.
→ Promotions move from quarterly to daily, with a six-month tier lock after promotion.
→ You can already preview your projected 2027 tier in Dev Dashboard.

Current tiers and benefits remain until January 1. These changes apply to service and agency partners, not the separate app and theme programs.

As someone working in Shopify development, I'm interested in how we measure real partner impact.

What about specialists who improve conversion, performance and revenue on stores they didn't originally launch?

Does this make partner recognition fairer, or just change who gets rewarded?

Official announcement: https://www.shopify.com/partners/blog/shopify-partner-program-tiers

#ShopifyPartners #EcommerceDevelopment
